skill.summary: Helps non-technical founders launch AI agents in 30 minutes without coding by using plain English and 3 ready-made workflows.

latestVersion.changelog:
Non-Technical Agent Quickstart 1.0.0

- First public release of the skill, focused on non-technical founders.
- Introduces a 5-step, plain-English, no-code process to launch your first AI agent.
- Includes beginner-friendly tool recommendations (Claude.ai Pro or OpenClaw; no coding or APIs required).
- Provides templates for agent job descriptions, prompts, and workflow integrations.
- Features 3 pre-built, copy-paste workflows: Email Assistant, Task Manager, and more to get started immediately.
- Designed for simplicity—just plain English instructions optimized for fast setup.
